sn46.20:1.1: “Bhikkhus, these seven factors of enlightenment, when developed and cultivated, lead to utter revulsion, to dispassion, to cessation, to peace, to direct knowledge, to enlightenment, to Nibbāna.
sn46.20:1.3: The enlightenment factor of mindfulness … the enlightenment factor of equanimity.
sn46.20:1.4: These seven factors of enlightenment … lead to Nibbāna.”
